SELECT
    p."name" AS product_name,
    CASE
        WHEN p."dining" = 1 THEN 'Prepared meal'
        WHEN p."dining" = 0 THEN 'Takeaway product'
    END AS product_type
FROM
    "products" p
WHERE
    p."best_before" = TO_DATE('10.11.2018', 'DD.MM.YYYY')
    AND (
        p."dining" = 1
        OR (p."dining" = 0 AND p."name" IN (
            SELECT p2."name"
            FROM "products" p2
            WHERE p2."best_before" = TO_DATE('10.11.2018', 'DD.MM.YYYY')
            AND p2."dining" = 1
        ))
    )
ORDER BY
    p."dining" DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

WITH hospital_role_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "mr"."roleid",
        "mr"."rolename",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "hmr"."hospitalid") AS hospital_count
    FROM
        "medicalroles" "mr"
    JOIN
        "hospitals_medical_roles" "hmr" ON "mr"."roleid" = "hmr"."roleid"
    GROUP BY
        "mr"."roleid", "mr"."rolename"
),
total_hospitals AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT "hospitalid") AS total
    FROM
        "hospitals"
)
SELECT
    "rolename"
FROM
    hospital_role_counts "hrc"
CROSS JOIN
    total_hospitals "th"
WHERE
    "hrc"."hospital_count" = "th"."total"
ORDER BY
    "rolename";

323:
